rules: One quest template per currently indexed publication.
Source-inspired hooks are original; not claims about actual book plots.
No canon NPC cameo without date/location validation.
No quest completion or rewards without DM approval.

quests.questTitle: The Lost Ledger — Dungeons & Dragons (Original boxed set)
quests.hook: While exploring a campaign-neutral frontier town, Alice encounters a vanished courier carrying a sealed map. The problem reflects themes suitable for Dungeons & Dragons (Original boxed set), but is a newly authored Moonveil scenario.
quests.objective: Investigate the situation, help those at risk, preserve evidence, and secure a DM-approved resolution.

fiveChoices.text: Honor the local agreement and negotiate safe passage.
Aid those in immediate danger even if the agreement is disputed.
Defy the corrupt gatekeeper and open a path for the stranded.
Examine the evidence, routes, and historical records.
Prepare defenses and confront the immediate threat.

branchHooks: Investigate a new lead in another sourcebook
Return later with a prerequisite item or ally
Revisit the location in a different historical era
Follow the faction consequences into a linked Moonveil book
